package.name: PackageStudio
package.description: Chip packaging assemblies in FreeCAD: GDS chips with a PDK technology (several at once), housings from a library, boards and parts as STEP; place and move them parametrically; pads, ports and symmetric bond wires; one material system; a ready-to-run openEMS, EMerge or Palace package with OTTER, and an EM assistant on a local Ollama model.
